items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: She was with Earl Dancer there, I remember on one occasion.

ctx.x: And it was a great place. Ethel Waters was there. She was with Earl Dancer there, I remember on one occasion. We had a big party there, about fifteen or eighteen of us. And it was Ethel Waters' turn and Earl Dancer HAD said to buy her a drink. And as soon as they'd turn around to buy a drink, they'd start fussin' amongst on to themselves and broke up the party and went on out and didn't pay the check.
